description: 悟空走路躯干、腰甲、胯部与双腿共享腰身变换；固定源图髋关节标定，贴图关节重叠，摆腿抬升缩小 25%。

connectivity.method: 180 assembled RGBA frames (ready plus fourteen staff variants, twelve gait phases), alpha >= 35, hip/knee/ankle neighborhoods within 1.5 world units all intersect the largest body component.

method: Isolated Playwright context with QA-only pause/seek access. D/A and D+J exercised with actual keyboard input after resource loading. No production debug hooks.
